assets.label: Firmware
assets.description: Requires a Waldorf Microwave II/XT ROM: a 256 KB dump, or its two 128 KB halves. An OS update .mid alone is not enough (it lacks the wavetables); beside a ROM it updates it. The loader finds them by content, so the names are free.
assets.hint: The emulator runs the Microwave's 68000 and its DSP on its own threads, off the audio thread. One Xenia at a time.
